gbm_population_evidence.quote: Histopathologically confirmed, based on biopsy or surgical resection, glioblastoma, or grade 4 astrocytoma, as defined by the World Health Organization (WHO)

candidate_evidence.quote: [RADIATION] Adaptive, two-phase RT: Participants in this arm will be treated with an adaptive, two-phase radiation therapy approach

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Biopsy or surgical resection performed ≤ 12 weeks prior to study entry

coder_notes: Radiotherapy-technique trial (MR-Linac adaptive RT), Phase NA. Concurrent systemic therapy is mentioned in eligibility but not named or registered as an intervention; gadolinium contrast is mentioned only in eligibility, not a registered intervention, so not listed (R9). 'Grade 4 astrocytoma' without IDH requirement and 'Glioblastoma Multiforme' -> historical terminology.
